prompt:
Create one pixel-art horizontal gaze atlas for the Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait shown in the single reference image. Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game portrait animation upper-half atlas.

The reference is a 2-by-2 grid of this exact happy portrait: top-left is open eyes looking image-left, top-right is open eyes looking image-right, bottom-left is half-closed eyes looking image-left, bottom-right is half-closed eyes looking image-right. Return exactly this same 2x2 arrangement, with four equal complete 64x35 upper-face cells and overall 128x70 aspect ratio. No gutters, labels, border, added area, or transparency.

Preserve identity, framing, hair, ornament, skin palette, the chosen happy asymmetrical brows, and the small smile creases at the outer eye corners. Preserve each source cell's eye opening and lid contour. In the two open cells, change only the horizontal gaze. BOTH amber irises and dark pupils must move together toward the SAME named canvas side in each cell: both toward image-left in top-left, both toward image-right in top-right. Keep natural inward convergence toward a shared distant point, but never make one pupil stay centered, make the pupils diverge, or make them point toward each other. Keep the source compact stepped iris size, amber-olive color, and tiny muted glint. No enlarged iris, round/vector eyeballs, broad white bands, bright patches, or new brow shape.

In the lower two cells, retain the exact half-closed aperture from the reference: the upper lids cover most of each iris and leave only the same narrow source-like opening/slit. Move both partially occluded iris/pupil clusters together horizontally in the named direction. Do not open the lower eyes wider, shrink the iris, or reveal extra sclera.

Pixel-art constraints: crisp native pixel clusters and restrained source palette, no antialiasing or smoothing, no extra eyes, no shifted face features. The portrait itself must not change outside the eye masks. Output only the atlas.
